How it works

Three steps from box to home.

☷

1 · Choose your layout

Select from pre-made floorplans — a 20ft or 40ft unit. We can also customise.

✎

2 · Select your finishes

Make it yours — benchtops, tapware, flooring and aircon, all your choice. Spec it and we price it on the spot.

🚚

3 · We build and deliver

Built in our factories, then trucked to your block or shipped to most major ports anywhere in Australia at no extra cost — plus 100km of road transport included free.
